item.title: 'Askers' vs. 'Guessers' (2010)
item.description:
📝 This article is from the archive of our partner. The 'requester' (whether of Asker or Guesser type) is in more in need of a 'yes' (or 'no') response from the 'requestee' (again, of either type) at some times than others. Therefore, it is perfectly sensible to be an Asker for some things at some times and a Guesser for other things (or even the same things) at another.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theatlantic.com/national/2010/05/askers-vs-guessers/340891/
